title: Mutual Praise

questions.question: Where has your beloved gone, O most beautiful among whom?
questions.explanation: Song of Solomon 6:1 (ESV): "Where has your beloved gone, O most beautiful among women?"

questions.question: My beloved has gone down to his what?
questions.explanation: Song of Solomon 6:2 (ESV): "My beloved has gone down to his garden,"

questions.question: I am my beloved's and my beloved is whose?
questions.explanation: Song of Solomon 6:3 (ESV): "I am my beloved's and my beloved is mine;"

questions.question: You are beautiful as Tirzah, my love, lovely as what?
questions.explanation: Song of Solomon 6:4 (ESV): "You are beautiful as Tirzah, my love, lovely as Jerusalem,"

questions.question: Turn away your eyes from me, for they what me?
questions.explanation: Song of Solomon 6:5 (ESV): "Turn away your eyes from me, for they overwhelm me--"

questions.question: There are sixty queens and eighty concubines, and virgins without what?
questions.explanation: Song of Solomon 6:8 (ESV): "and virgins without number."

questions.question: My dove, my perfect one, is the only one of her what?
questions.explanation: Song of Solomon 6:9 (ESV): "My dove, my perfect one, is the only one... pure to her who bore her."

questions.question: Who is this who looks down like the what?
questions.explanation: Song of Solomon 6:10 (ESV): "Who is this who looks down like the dawn,"

questions.question: I went down to the nut orchard to look at the blossoms of the what?
questions.explanation: Song of Solomon 6:11 (ESV): "I went down to the nut orchard to look at the blossoms of the valley,"

questions.question: Before I was aware, my desire set me among the chariots of my whom?
questions.explanation: Song of Solomon 6:12 (ESV): "my desire set me among the chariots of my kinsman,"

questions.question: Return, return, O Shulammite, return, return, that we may look upon whom?
questions.explanation: Song of Solomon 6:13 (ESV): "Return, return, O Shulammite, return, return, that we may look upon you."

questions.question: Why should you look upon the Shulammite, as upon a dance before two what?
questions.explanation: Song of Solomon 6:13 (ESV): "Why should you look upon the Shulammite, as upon a dance before two armies?"

questions.question: You are awesome as an army with what?
questions.explanation: Song of Solomon 6:4 (ESV): "awesome as an army with banners."

questions.question: Your teeth are like a flock of ewes that have come up from the what?
questions.explanation: Song of Solomon 6:6 (ESV): "Your teeth are like a flock of ewes that have come up from the washing,"

questions.question: To see whether the vines had budded, whether the pomegranates were in what?
questions.explanation: Song of Solomon 6:11 (ESV): "whether the pomegranates were in bloom."

key_verse_text: I am my beloved's and my beloved is mine; he grazes among the lilies.
